method: Built-in imagegen, transparent background, reference-guided generation
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: PocketQuest blue slime battle sprite animation atlas, for a tiny 240x135 display and a pixel-art browser RPG.
Input image: attached blue slime is the identity/color reference only, not an edit target; its white backdrop MUST NOT be reproduced.
Create ONE transparent RGBA sprite atlas, 4 columns by 2 rows, exactly eight separate complete poses, equally spaced with very generous fully transparent gutters. No labels, grid, text, borders, ground scenery or baked drop shadows.
Character: small cute chibi blue gelatinous slime, cyan highlights and deep blue base, two large red/maroon eyes, shiny white reflections, a squat pear-shaped mound resting on a small puddle base; keep the reference identity but simplify into readable crisp fantasy pixel art, dark blue outline and discrete pixel clusters. No limbs, weapons, hats, shield prop, extra creatures or magic symbols. Target native body roughly 30x30 pixels, not detailed smooth illustration.
Battle direction: consistently facing LEFT in elevated three-quarter presentation, toward an opponent on the left. Ground base in each cell remains on the same baseline and at the same horizontal body anchor. Same character size and palette throughout; pose deformation only, never scale a whole frame independently.
Reading order, four columns in the top row: (1) standing idle gently rounded with open eyes, (2) idle slight squash ready to bounce, (3) defensive/blocking squat compressed mound with determined narrowed red eyes, (4) attack wind-up body pulled slightly right preparing to lunge left.
Four columns in bottom row: (5) attacking lunge LEFT, low body stretched to the left with small blue droplets, no large effects, (6) attack recovery returning to upright body facing left, (7) hurt recoil with tightly squinted eyes compressed slightly to right, (8) defeated harmless flattened blue puddle with closed eyes, not gore, not explosion.
Draw all eight poses with similar space occupied per slot. Keep even the defeated puddle on the shared baseline. Plenty of transparent room all around every pose, all droplets inside their own cells, no touching between cells. Genuine transparency outside the slime; do not paint a checkerboard or white background. Clean nearest-neighbor pixel-art look and readable red eyes.
cleanupPrompt: Edit only the transparency cleanup of this eight-pose blue pixel-art slime sheet. Keep exactly the same 4-column 2-row arrangement, slime poses, palette, red eyes, left-facing direction, body proportions and clean blue outline. Remove ALL stray speckles, faint blue/gray wisps, edge noise and nearly transparent ghost pixels outside each slime silhouette and its intentional round blue droplets. Outside the eight isolated sprite silhouettes and intentional droplets, every pixel must have alpha exactly ZERO. Give each complete sprite ample empty transparent gutters and room around it. No background, no checkerboard, no drop shadows, no labels, no new objects. Especially eliminate faint noisy ghost trails between/under poses without changing their actual silhouette. Maintain discrete crisp pixel clusters inside sprites, genuinely transparent RGBA background.
